findings.issue: No contractual agreement has been signed between the RE (Ganga Finance) and the LSP (FastFunds), which is a requirement for digital lending arrangements.
findings.doc_evidence: The two sides agreed the terms on a call and will start lending next week; no written contract has been signed.
findings.fix: A formal written contract must be established between Ganga Finance and FastFunds, clearly defining the roles, rights, and obligations of each party.

findings.issue: Ganga Finance did not conduct enhanced due diligence on FastFunds, including reviewing their technical capabilities, data privacy policies, past conduct, and ability to comply with regulations.
findings.doc_evidence: Ganga Finance did not review FastFunds' technology, data privacy policies or past conduct before agreeing, because FastFunds is a well-known brand.
findings.fix: Ganga Finance must perform a thorough due diligence process on FastFunds, including assessing their technical capabilities, data privacy policies, past conduct, and regulatory compliance.

findings.issue: Ganga Finance has not provided any guidance or training to FastFunds on fair recovery practices, despite FastFunds acting as a recovery agent.
findings.doc_evidence: Ganga Finance has given FastFunds no guidance or training on fair recovery practices.
findings.fix: Ganga Finance must provide FastFunds with necessary guidance on fair recovery practices to ensure compliance with applicable instructions.

findings.issue: No information is provided on whether the recovery agent's details are communicated to the borrower before contact for recovery.
findings.doc_evidence: FastFunds will also act as the recovery agent for overdue loans.
findings.fix: Ganga Finance must ensure that the details of the recovery agent (FastFunds) are communicated to the borrower via email/SMS before the recovery agent contacts the borrower.

findings.issue: The outsourcing agreement with FastFunds may dilute or absolve Ganga Finance of its obligations, as no written contract has been signed and due diligence was not performed.
findings.doc_evidence: The two sides agreed the terms on a call and will start lending next week; no written contract has been signed. Ganga Finance did not review FastFunds' technology, data privacy policies or past conduct before agreeing, because FastFunds is a well-known brand.
findings.fix: A formal written contract must be established, and due diligence must be conducted to ensure that Ganga Finance remains fully responsible and liable for all acts and omissions of FastFunds.

findings.issue: No mention is made of periodic reviews of FastFunds' conduct in compliance with the contractual agreement.
findings.doc_evidence: FastFunds keeps only the borrower's name, phone and address needed for collections.
findings.fix: Ganga Finance must implement a process for periodic review of FastFunds' conduct vis-à-vis the terms of the contractual agreement and take appropriate action in case of deviations.
